note: projector itself as patchwork cards. projector is a personal work-management app over a markdown vault (README.md at the repo root); its URL is its view (principle C9), and `?embed=view` / `?embed=sidebar` / `?embed=note` (src/web/embed.ts) draw one half of the app inside another page's frame, reporting the query up and taking a navigation down. So each card here is the real app in a frame — board, table, graph, calendar, the sidebar, or the note panel — with full functionality, and the card's own code only carries the URL between the frame and the workspace's focus channel: the query as a pj.view ref, the open note as a pj.note ref. Rewritten 2026-09-05 from hand-drawn projections to the app itself, on request. A workspace references this manifest by URL and does not vendor the files.

focusRefTypes.name: pj.view
focusRefTypes.description: A projector view as its query string (view=…&group=…&sort=…&q=…&f.<facet>=…), the way projector's own URL carries it. Shape is left out: each card is one shape.

focusRefTypes.name: pj.note
focusRefTypes.description: A projector note, by its id — the markdown file's identity in the vault.

cards.name: Sidebar
cards.subtitle: projector's sidebar: views, search, group, sort, filters
cards.intent: Hosts projector's own sidebar (?embed=sidebar) in a frame for the workspace's vault, asked from api.projector.meta.v1. Every control in it — saved views, search, group, sort, filters, focus — is the real one; whenever its query changes the card selects the query as a pj.view ref, and a pj.view or pj.note selected elsewhere is navigated into the frame. Shape is left out of the ref: each shape card is one shape.

cards.name: Board
cards.subtitle: projector's board, the app itself
cards.intent: Hosts projector's own board (?embed=view&shape=board) in a frame for the workspace's vault, asked from api.projector.meta.v1: drag between columns, keyboard, every write are the app's. Follows the pj.view selected on the focus channel — actionable when none is — and the pj.note selection; a card opened inside the frame does not slide its panel over the shape — it becomes the pj.note selection, and the Note card shows it.

cards.name: Note
cards.subtitle: projector's note panel, the app itself
cards.intent: Hosts projector's own note panel (?embed=note) in a frame for the workspace's vault, asked from api.projector.meta.v1, showing the pj.note selected on the focus channel: title, facets, body editor, links, the work starter — every write is the app's. With no note selected it says so. A note the panel navigates to (a link, a parent) becomes the pj.note selection for every card.
